day.headline: A Dragon day — Rat and Monkey are in step.

reasons: Monkey and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: being tired in a specific way
signs.message: That specific fried feeling means talk to nobody until noon.

reasons: Dragon's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: posture at the end of the day
signs.message: Notice how you're sitting at 9pm. Sit up, whole day improves.

signs.message: That mystery bag from March? Thaw it, eat it tonight.

signs.message: Free, technically. Read the fine print, then take it anyway.
